title: Alex Rivera: spreadsheets to invoicing software
subtitle: journey cj_001 · action path · nodes marked illustrative are invented for this prototype

persona.name: Alex Rivera
persona.goal: Find a reliable and affordable invoicing software

scenario: Alex needs to switch from manual spreadsheets to an automated invoicing tool to save time.

nodes.label: Realizes manual invoicing takes too much time
Searches Google for 'best small business invoicing tools'
nodes.thought: There are too many options. Which one is actually simple to use?
opportunities: Publish a clear, interactive feature and pricing comparison guide

nodes.label: Talks it over with the team
Signs up for a free 14-day trial
nodes.thought: I hope setting up my first invoice doesn't take longer than 10 minutes.
pains: Blank dashboard upon first login without a quick-start template
opportunities: Add a 1-minute interactive setup wizard upon sign-up

nodes.label: Picks a competitor's tool instead
nodes.thought: Their sign-up looked quicker. I will not risk another blank screen.
pains: No way to see the product working before committing
opportunities: Show a 60-second demo on the landing page

sections.head: What it tells us
items: The trial sign-up is where Alex is won or lost

nodes.label: Enters credit card details for the monthly plan
Generates and sends the first client invoice
nodes.thought: That was fast and painless. Let's see how clients react to the link.
opportunities: Send a transparent receipt and a one-click calendar reminder before trial ends

nodes.label: Receives first online payment from a client
Contacts live chat with a tax-formatting question
nodes.thought: Support answered in 2 minutes. This is worth the monthly subscription.
pains: Difficulty finding local tax settings documentation
opportunities: Proactively surface regional tax setup tooltips in the settings panel

annotations.text: Alex wants a second opinion before paying for anything.
